title: Commissioning Project Manager
description:
DLB Associates is a premier engineering and consulting firm specializing in innovative, mission-critical solutions across hyperscale data centers, advanced infrastructure, and high-performance building systems. With over four decades of expertise, we partner with some of the world’s most influential companies to design and optimize environments that demand precision, scalability, and resilience.
Join us and be part of a team where your voice matters, your work makes an impact, and your growth is a shared priority.
Position Title: Commissioning Project Manager
Position Location: Remote - United States. Must be located near a major airport.
Travel Requirements: Up to 50% domestic travel. Must have a valid driver’s license and ability to rent vehicles.
JOB SUMMARY
The Commissioning Project Manager provides technical support and leadership to plan, schedule and execute full life cycle commissioning of critical facilities. This person participates in the MEP design review process and participates in functional testing of complex electrical and mechanical systems.
The Commissioning Project Manager is responsible for supporting all aspects of a project. This person will work as part of the project team and interact closely with the owners, designers, contractors, subcontractors and other trades on projects in mission critical environments.
The role may assist with developing and evaluating bid proposals, developing commissioning plans and schedules, facilitating communication and ensuring compliance with owner’s requirements, applicable laws, and specifications.
This person will collaborate with design engineers, construction contractors, equipment vendors, client staff and the DLB commissioning team to test, validate and make operational newly installed and operational electrical and mechanical systems including those in mission critical facilities.
The Commissioning Project Manager will receive limited directions on day-to-day work and general instruction on new projects or assignments. Will execute commissioning and assist project leadership on projects of complex scope. Will work independently or under limited supervision.
This person will communicate and operate in line with organizational goals and values, as well as departmental objectives.
ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS
Manage all Elements of Commissioning Projects (50%)

• Assist with pre-construction elements including project initiation, kickoff, RFIs and submittals

• Coordinate and support resource and material forecasting

• Develop, manage and monitor schedule

• Participate in, schedule or lead project meetings

• Coordinate / perform QA / QC and Cx plans and specifications to ensure completion in accordance with the project scope and appropriate guidelines and manuals

• Communicate and coordinate project staffing needs.

• Coordinate or oversee start-up, cutover, pre-functional or functional testing and project closeout

• Onboard project team for mobilization

• Prepare project progress reports for internal and external stakeholders

• Lead and assist in preparation of final commissioning report for submission to client

Monitor and Control Project Financials (15%)

• Prepare, forecast and monitor project budgets, profitability, margins, bill rates and utilization and maintain overall responsibility for the profitability of the project

• Communicate with the client when additional fees / change orders are required

• Identify potential project risks and develop / implement strategies to minimize impact and control deviations from estimated costs and project deadlines

Manage Stakeholder Relations (15%)

• Assist in the preparation of proposals, presentations and the overall marketing efforts of the firm

• Assist in the promotion of the firm, service and expertise to existing or potential clients

• Maintain client relationship to ensure an ongoing positive relationship and work with clients to identify and develop new projects

• Support contact for clients and build effect

title: System Integration and Test Engineer, Space Systems
description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE TEAM

Anduril’s Space Manufacturing team is seeking a System Integration and Test Engineer to join our team. The Space Manufacturing team is responsible for assembly, integration, and test of ground support equipment, PCBA, unit-level, and integrated systems that are vital for our aerospace and defense operations. Your expertise will help ensure that our products meet the highest standards of quality and reliability at Anduril. The right person for this role can demonstrate past holistic ownership in solving a technical challenge with a creative, physical solution that they either personally manufactured or oversaw the manufacturing of, in a fast-paced, resource-limited environment. If you are someone who thrives in such an environment, then this role is for you.

WHAT YOU’LL DO 

• Lead and participate in system integration and test campaigns, developing test plans, test procedures, and schedules, coordinating resource needs, test equipment, and test facility needs.

• Lead test readiness reviews (TRRs) for flight hardware.

• Participate in manufacturing readiness reviews (MRRs) for flight hardware.

• Develop, document, and continuously improve processes for the manufacturing, assembly, and integration of PCBAs and box-level assemblies, and space vehicles, ensuring compliance with space-grade standards.

• Perform hands-on hardware and software testing at unit-level and system level.

• Perform detailed root cause analyses (RCA) and drive corrective actions for non-conformances/anomalies identified during integration and test.

• Specify, procure, and maintain assembly tools, fixtures, and equipment required for integration and test.

• Communicate with supply chain, hardware teams, program management, and test teams to manage priorities and resolve technical challenges.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS 

• 5+ years of experience in aerospace, aviation, military, or other high-reliability industries, including 2+ years in hands-on integration and test of flight or comparably high-reliability hardware.

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or another technical discipline.

• A working, cross-disciplinary understanding of both mechanical and electrical engineering - comfortable interpreting mechanical drawings and GD&T as well as electrical schematics, troubleshooting across both mechanical hardware and electrical/electronic systems, and interfacing with design engineers to address DFM/DFA challenges.

• 3+ years of hands-on experience in unit-level, space-vehicle, or system integration, assembly, and environmental testing, with direct involvement in at least 2 of: vibration, thermal vacuum, acoustic, shock, or EMI/EMC.

• Hands-on integration or test experience with electro-optical/infrared (EO/IR) or comparable sensor and payload systems - at least 1 such area, and preferably more than one (e.g., EO/IR, RF/communications, or optical instruments).

• 3+ years of practical, hands-on experience using test equipment such as oscilloscopes, network analyzers, power supplies, electronic loads, and DAQs.

Location : Remote

About Flosum
Flosum is a rapidly growing B2B SaaS organization. In a high-growth environment, our Go-To-Market (GTM) revenue engine is our most critical asset. We are building a tightly aligned, high-performance engine, and we need a tactical marketing leader to step in and own the growth framework.
Role Overview
We are not looking for a theoretical, high-level consultant who only delegates. We are looking for a Fractional Marketing Leader who is a true "Doer." Your primary mission is simple: You will completely own the enterprise pipeline. You will shield the CEO from daily marketing operational noise, step in to actively manage and lead our current marketing team, and build a predictable, scalable enterprise demand-generation engine.

• Pipeline Ownership: Take full accountability for the creation, tracking, and velocity of the enterprise-grade sales pipeline (MQL to SQL to Pipeline Value).

• Team Management: Act as the direct leader for the internal marketing team, establishing KPIs, clearing roadblocks, and managing day-to-day execution.

description:
POSITION TITLE: Director, Capital Markets
Position Summary:
The Director of Capital Markets provides strategic leadership for capital markets activities supporting reverse mortgage portfolios, with specialized expertise in Home Equity Conversion Mortgages (HECM), HECM remediation, and secondary market execution. This role is responsible for optimizing loan sale strategies, managing investor relationships, ensuring regulatory compliance, and leading remediation initiatives that mitigate operational, financial, and reputational risk.
To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. Examples below:

• Direct HECM remediation initiatives by identifying loan deficiencies, overseeing corrective action plans, and ensuring timely resolution of FHA, HUD, and Ginnie Mae compliance issues to reduce repurchase risk and financial exposure.
• Work in conjunction with other departments and third parties to execute requests and create process efficiencies
• Support execution of HECM securitizations, loan sales, and related capital markets transactions.
• Monitor changes to FHA, Ginnie Mae, and investor requirements affecting reverse mortgage products.
• Maintain expertise in FHA reverse mortgage regulations, HECM program requirements, and investor guidelines.

Key Result Areas:

• Leadership and oversight of operational processes supporting HECM delivery and capital markets execution.
• Drive continuous process and execution improvement initiatives
• Ensure timely movement of loans into HMBS pools or investor delivery channels.
• Allocate resources and drive accountability to direct reports to ensure achievement of results

Qualifications:
To perform this job successfully, an individual must have the following education and/or experience:
• A bachelor’s degree is required.
• An MBA is strongly preferred.
Industry Experience

• A minimum of 10 years in the mortgage industry, with at least 5 years in capital markets. This includes progressively increasing responsibilities and leadership roles, as well as experience with GNMA, Agency TBA (buy/sell sides), Non-Agency private placements, HMBS markets, and advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel.
• At least 5 years of experience in analyzing, trading, and managing securitization products. Candidates should possess custom/specification trading expertise, preferably with exposure to MBS derivatives and Mortgage Servicing Rights, and have proven capability in addressing complex technical, administrative, and managerial challenges.

Training / Licensing Requirements:

• Must pass the Company’s Background Screening process prior to beginning employment. Additionally, as a condition of employment, you may be required to pass client-specific background check requirements or Federal/State licensing requirements, if applicable.

The salary range for this position is expected to be $160k-180k per year, depending on geographic location, experience, and other qualifications of the successful candidate. This position is also eligible for bonus based on performance and subject to the terms of the Company’s applicable plans.

title: Staff Product Manager, Nexus
description:
ROLE SUMMARY

We’re hiring a Staff Product Manager, Nexus to own the next phase of Temporal Nexus: landing the current product foundation, expanding adoption across strategic accounts, and defining the roadmap for Nexus as Temporal’s durable connectivity layer.

This person will take over an active, technically deep product area with real customer usage and a fast-moving roadmap. The immediate work is to land the in-flight Nexus developer experience and operator-control work with quality. The longer-term mandate is to shape the next wave: Connector Ecosystem, Service Hub, and Agentic Communication Fabric.

This is not a “write specs and wait” role. The PM will need to build trust quickly with engineering, customers, field teams, and GTM; understand the product hands-on; turn messy customer evidence into sequencing decisions; and create the narrative that helps Temporal, customers, and partners understand where Nexus is going.

WHAT YOU’LL OWN

- Nexus product strategy and roadmap. Prioritize the work that makes Nexus the durable connectivity layer across teams, namespaces, services, and AI systems.

- Current execution. Drive completion of in-flight work such as the new Nexus developer experience, Standalone Nexus Operations, connector foundations, caller identity, rate limits, and payload encryption.

- Customer discovery and evidence. Stay close to design partners and strategic customers like Netflix, Duolingo, and Miro.

- Developer and operator experience. Balance SDK ergonomics, schema-first contracts, codegen, service discovery, security, visibility, and control-plane needs.

- Cross-functional launch and enablement. Make sure everyone in the company understands the problems Nexus solves and knows how to sell / deploy / support it.

- Success metrics. Define adoption and momentum measures: activated accounts, completed Nexus operations, shared-service usage, SDK coverage, design-partner progress, and field readiness.

WHAT YOU’LL BRING

- Staff-level product judgment. 8+ years in product management or equivalent experience turning ambiguous and technical strategy into shipped outcomes.

- Strong technical depth. Ability to reason about distributed systems, workflow orchestration, service-to-service communication, APIs, SDKs, identity, and authorization.

- Developer-platform experience. Experience with infrastructure, platforms, integrations, APIs, SDKs, service mesh, API gateways, or cloud developer products.

- Customer and field orientation. Comfortable working directly with senior technical customers and enabling GTM teams on a complex product.

- Excellent writing and narrative skills. Able to create crisp strategy docs, roadmap narratives, launch materials, and decision memos.

- Execution discipline. Can inherit a complicated roadmap, clarify ownership, unblock decisions, and keep the team focused.

WHO YOU ARE

- You want to build important infrastructure. You’re motivated by products that sit in the critical path for customers and developers. You want to work on something foundational, technically deep, and category-defining.

- You operate with ownership. You don’t measure your job by meetings, specs, or process completed. You measure it by customer outcomes, product adoption, team clarity, and whether the right work actually ships.

The Company operates three lines of business: medical record retrieval; medical record review and coding; and in-home health assessments. description:
At LendingPoint , we believe that everyone deserves to feel the power of possibilities. As an online fintech company, we’ve created advanced consumer, small business, and merchant point-of-sale lending solutions to unlock access to affordable loans and empower those working to build their financial potential. By creating technology that sees your potential, we’re driving a better lending and borrowing experience by finding more reasons to say “yes.”

• Team Oriented Fast-Paced Fun Environment

• Dedicated and experienced Management Team

What You’ll Do Day to Day:

• Collaborate with product and engineering teams to deploy models into production environment.

• Work with stakeholders throughout the organization to identify opportunities for leveraging company data to drive business solutions.

• Optimize complex SQL programs for speed and efficiency.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS:

• Bachelor’s in a quantitative field (e.g., Mathematics, Data Science, Statistics, Economics, Finance, etc.). Master’s / PhD degree preferred.

• 4+ years’ experience in fintech or financial services applying advanced statistical and machine learning predictive techniques.

• Expert knowledge in statistical programming languages such as Python, R, and database languages such as SQL

• Knowledge of advanced statistical modeling, testing, data mining, ETL, and data science techniques.

• Experience using GCP and/or Hadoop systems for distributed analytics and data processing.

• Strong communication and interpersonal skills.

• Ability to work in fast-paced environment.

Bei GALVANY ist es unser Ziel, klimaneutrales Wohnen für alle zur Realität zu machen. Wir setzen auf Umsetzung und entwickeln konkrete, smarte Lösungen, indem wir Wärmepumpen, Batteriespeicher und Smart Metering einfach zugänglich, zuverlässig und bezahlbar machen.

Wir sind ein profitables Greentech-Startup und glauben, dass nachhaltiger Impact und langfristiges Wachstum nur auf Basis eines gesunden Geschäftsmodells möglich sind. Um unsere ambitionierte Tech Roadmap umzusetzen haben wir im Frühjahr 2026 eine Seed-Finanzierung in Höhe von 10 Millionen Euro mit Set Ventures und AENU abgeschlossen. Getrieben von Kundennutzen, Klarheit und Verantwortung stehen wir für hochwertige Heizlösungen und ein Arbeitsumfeld, in dem Menschen Verantwortung übernehmen und nachhaltigen Mehrwert schaffen.

Als Werkstudent Erneuerbare Energien (m/w/d) bei GALVANY führst du gemeinsam mit unseren Kund:innen digitale Hausaufnahmen durch und legst damit den Grundstein für eine reibungslose Wärmepumpeninstallation. Du arbeitest eng mit unseren Auftragsmanager:innen zusammen und bringst dein bautechnisches Verständnis direkt in unseren Feinplanungsprozess ein.

Deine Aufgaben

- Du führst gemeinsam mit unseren Kund:innen Online-Termine zur digitalen Hausaufnahme durch, unterstützt durch unser Feinplanungstool und Screensharing.

- Du bereitest Kund:innen im Vorfeld auf den Termin vor (z. B. Hinweise zu Grundriss, Smartphone, stabiler Internetverbindung) gemäß unserem standardisierten Kommunikationsprozess.

- Du nimmst relevante bautechnische Details digital auf und dokumentierst diese strukturiert im Feinplanungstool.

- Du lädst die abgeschlossene Feinplanung fach- und termingerecht hoch und stellst so die Grundlage für die weitere Projektsteuerung sicher.

- Du arbeitest eng mit deinem zuständigen Auftragsmanager zusammen, der/die dich fachlich koordiniert und deine Projekte priorisiert.

Dein Profil

- Laufendes Studium im Bereich Architektur, Bauingenieurwesen, Elektrotechnik, Energiemanagement oder einem vergleichbaren technischen Studiengang.

- 20h pro Woche Verfügbarkeit

- Sicherer Umgang mit digitalen Tools, neue Software erlernst du schnell.

- Fließende Deutschkenntnisse (C2-Niveau)

Zusätzlich sind uns folgende Fähigkeiten und Eigenschaften wichtig:

- Reliable Executor: Du hältst Termine und Deadlines zuverlässig ein und lieferst gleichbleibend hohe Qualität ab.

- Technical Understanding: Du verstehst bautechnische Zusammenhänge schnell und überträgst sie präzise in unser Feinplanungstool.

- Customer-Facing Communicator: Du trittst Kund:innen gegenüber freundlich und kompetent auf und schaffst auch im Online-Termin eine vertrauensvolle Atmosphäre.

- Structured Worker: Du gehst methodisch vor und dokumentierst deine Ergebnisse klar und nachvollziehbar.

Benefits

- Werde Teil eines schnell wachsenden und profitablen Climate-Tech-Startups

- Attraktive und wettbewerbsfähige Vergütung

- Unser lebendiges Office ist das Herz unserer Kultur und fördert Zusammenarbeit und Austausch vor Ort

- Hybrides Arbeitsmodell mit anteiligem Homeoffice nach der Einarbeitung

- Individuelle Benefits, abgestimmt auf deine Bedürfnisse, z. B. Sportmitgliedschaften, ÖPNV-Ticket oder Learning Budget

title: Scrum Master
description:
What is the position?

As a Scrum Master, you love contributing to the in-depth growth of development teams brought together for our clients. You will focus on the agile process of the team, support this process by making it more efficient and improving collaboration. In a nutshell, your most important task is to facilitate a good development process of the team. You enthuse the team to follow specific methodologies and solve any roadblocks the team encounters within their process. You also coach the team in their agile abilities and answer any process related questions from both the team as well as other stakeholders.

What are you going to do?

You will be part of a young and growing organization that aims to develop the best cross-platform mobile apps out there. As a Scrum Master, you’ll be responsible for creating a team spirit within a group of developers. You’ll act as a link between our developers, clients and third parties and keep the focus on the end goal. In addition, you’ll ensure that you will keep an open attitude but remain critical to make sure requirements are met for the customer while keeping everyone informed on project progress, status, schedule, deadlines, and releases.

You’ll be transparent and open about the choices made and to be made. You’ll know the ins and outs of the market and translate this into user stories. You’ll also be realistic and pragmatic and willing to cooperate.

Who are we looking for?

For this position, we are looking for someone who has very strong communication skills, experience with a role as a Scrum Master in an Agile work environment and an interest in the world of app development.

Ideally, you have some (Xamaring, C#, .NET) programming experience and you have at least two years’ experience in a comparable position. A PSM II certification is a big plus! You should also be aware of the ins and outs of the market and be able to translate this to user stories. Last but not least, you have a completed Masters Degree or equivalent.

Who is XABLU?

XABLU is a leader in cross-platform mobile app development and consultancy. From boosting our clients’ development teams to helping them refine their mobile strategy: we are there to support them with all of their app development needs. In addition, we host events where developers can talk about technology, hack and socialize. We are known for our deep expertise in the Microsoft Xamarin mobile ecosystem as well as our signature friendly and efficient team approach.

We also have internal projects we are developing: one is a user-centered platform combined with blockchain, and the other is a platform with a lot of automation challenges!

XABLU is a remote-first company: team and communication are our top priority and we embrace different cultures as well as different geo-locations. At XABLU, you’ll be working in an environment where you can express your talents, ideas and personality. You’ll be pushed by your colleagues to develop yourself and the team in an informal and fun atmosphere.

Your Profile

• Experience with a role as Scrum Master

• Strong communication skills

• Interest in app development

• Enjoy managing people and projects

• Good at prioritizing and planning

• Ideally, programming experience

• Completed Master Degree or equivalent

• Prefarably having PSM II certification or willing to obtain it

• Used to working with a team and to build up dynamics

• Available for 32-40 hours per week

title: Senior Coatings & Corrosion Consultant
description:
Structural Integrity Associates (SIA) is seeking a Senior Coatings & Corrosion Consultant to help build and grow our coatings and linings service offerings within the nuclear power industry. This position may be based remotely or in one of our office locations.

This role combines technical execution, client engagement, and business development. The selected candidate will support existing coating-related work while playing a key role in expanding SIA’s presence in areas such as internal linings, protective coatings, and corrosion mitigation strategies for critical plant assets.

This is a high-visibility, growth-oriented role with the opportunity to shape a developing service line and directly influence its long-term success. The position will also support research and development (R&D) programs, field applications, and technical consulting for clients.

The work environment within SIA is highly collaborative, leveraging expertise across Structural Integrity (e.g., Materials, Chemistry, Vibration, Advanced Reactors) to deliver solutions that enhance component reliability, extend service life, and improve safety.

Primary Responsibilities:

• Lead and support coating and linings projects for nuclear plant systems involving coating selection, qualification, performance assessment, and application for nuclear and industrial applications

• Lead or support commercial grade dedication (CGD) of coatings and lining systems, including identification of critical characteristics, development of dedication plans, supplier evaluation, and ensuring compliance with 10 CFR 50 Appendix B quality assurance requirements

• Develop technical scopes of work, specifications, and inspection plans

• Evaluate coating degradation, failure mechanisms, and life extension strategies

• Support field activities including contractor oversight and QA

• Interface with clients to identify needs and develop follow-on work

• Contribute to business development by identifying opportunities, developing proposals and engaging with clients

• Collaborate internally to cross sell SI offerings, bundle services, and expand scope

• Develop standardized approaches and best practices

• Author and review technical reports, test plans, and client deliverables

• Engage in client consulting, troubleshooting, and field application support

Required Skills/Qualifications:

• Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Materials Science, or related field (or equivalent experience)

• 5-15+ years in coatings, corrosion, linings, or asset integrity

• Direct experience supporting commercial grade dedication (CGD) of materials or components and working within 10 CFR 50 Appendix B nuclear quality assurance programs

• Experience in specification, inspection, assessment, or rehabilitation

• Strong client-facing and communication skills

title: Medical Transcriptionist / Medical Scribe
description:
Job Description: Sr. Medical Transcriptionist/ Medical Scribe (Full Time) (Night Shift)
We are currently seeking experienced candidates to join our team as Sr. Medical Transcriptionists/Medical Scribes in a full-time position with night shift hours. This role involves working closely with leading radiologists in the USA, transcribing live and offline dictations across different modalities such as X-ray, CT, Ultrasound, and more. The primary responsibility is to accurately transcribe dictations, prepare reports, and assist radiologists in completing error-free reports.
Key Responsibilities:

• Transcribe dictations: Listen to radiology dictations and accurately transcribe them into written reports, ensuring precision and clarity in the documentation of medical information.

• Collaborate with Radiologists: Work alongside radiologists in a live environment, assisting them during procedures and documenting findings in real-time.

• Offline transcription: Transcribe dictations from audio recordings outside of live settings, taking full responsibility for delivering accurate and timely transcriptions.

• Prepare reports: Utilize transcribed information to prepare concise and comprehensive reports, maintaining formatting and adhering to specific guidelines.

• Maintain speed and accuracy: Demonstrate excellent typing skills with a minimum speed of 30 words per minute (WPM) to ensure efficiency in transcribing dictations and report generation.

• Night shift availability: Exhibit flexibility and willingness to work night shifts in alignment with our operations.

• Strong communication skills: Possess effective written and spoken communication skills to collaborate with radiologists and other team members, ensuring clear and accurate documentation.

• Basic computer skills: Utilize computers and relevant software systems efficiently to manage and organize medical records, transcriptions, and reports.

• Ability to work as a team: Collaborate effectively with the healthcare team, supporting and assisting colleagues to ensure smooth and error-free operations.

• Continuous learning: Show enthusiasm for learning and adapting to evolving technologies, medical procedures, and guidelines.

Requirements:

• Minimum of 2 years of experience in Medical Transcription.

• Medical transcription certification or prior experience in the field is highly desirable.

• Good communication skills, both written and spoken, to effectively interact with radiologists and team members.

• Strong listening skills to accurately transcribe dictations and capture essential details.

• Typing speed of over 30 words per minute (WPM).

• Comfortable working night shifts in alignment with our operational requirements.

• Basic computer skills, including proficiency in relevant software applications for documentation and record management.

• Demonstrated ability to work well in a team environment and contribute collaboratively.

• Immediate availability for joining.

• Virtual interview process will be conducted.

If you possess a minimum of 2 years of experience in Medical Transcription, have excellent communication and listening skills, and are ready to work night shifts, we encourage you to apply for this challenging and rewarding position. Join our dedicated team and work closely with leading radiologists in the USA, contributing to the accurate and efficient generation of medical reports.

title: Employer Growth Manager
description:

Tiro is in growth. We’re not a start-up figuring out if this works, but we’re not a corporate machine either. We’re an established SME with high growth plans & things are starting to accelerate...

We partner with industry to solve real workforce challenges through science and technology apprenticeships. We don’t just deliver training - we help organisations build the capability they need to grow, by developing job-ready talent that drives measurable business impact.

Why this role (and why now) We work closely with employers in science and tech & our clients are at an inflection point - Their sectors are under real pressure to build capability, not just hire around it. That’s driving a different kind of conversation. More strategic. More commercially relevant. Higher stakes.

And that’s presenting a growth opportunity & dictating how we grow. We’re building a sharper, more focused growth engine:

• clearer verticals

• better-quality conversations

• stronger partnerships

• and a more deliberate approach to winning business

That’s where you come in.

The role

You love the new business role - but you’re not a typical biz dev manager.

Yes, you know you’ll be expected to go out, build pipeline and close deals. That part is non-negotiable.

But the art of how you do it, matters just as much to you.

You enjoy operating as a consultative growth partner , not a transactional seller.

You spend time understanding how businesses actually work - where their capability gaps are, how they grow, and where apprenticeships can genuinely add value.

You enjoy better conversations.
Better-qualified opportunities.
And ultimately, better deals.

You’ll own the full journey - from first conversation through to close - and you’ll be expected to close cleanly. Clear scope, aligned expectations, no mess handed into delivery.

It’s a role with autonomy, but also accountability. You’ll have a number. You’ll be trusted to figure things out. And you’ll be expected to deliver.

Who this works for

You’re already in a sales, business development or growth role - and you’ve realised you want more from it.

Your growth mindset demands; More depth. More challenge. More learning.

You enjoy winning. Properly.

Not just getting deals over the line but understanding why they should exist in the first place.

You’re curious - you ask better questions, you listen properly, and you don’t rush to pitch. You’re commercially minded and target-driven, and you’ve got high standards.

You care about what you sell and how you sell it.

You build relationships that last, not just deals that close. And you’ve got resilience. You don’t expect things to land first time, and you don’t lose momentum when they don’t.

Where Tiro takes you

This is the kind of role where, if you lean into it, you don’t just hit target - you level up. You’ll develop real capability in:

• consultative and strategic selling

• navigating more complex buying environments

• building deep expertise in specific sectors and verticals

• and understanding how a business actually scales

You’ll also be part of shaping how we grow - not just executing someone else’s playbook.

You’ll start with an initial conversation to understand your background and what you’re looking for. From there, we’ll go deeper into how you think about sales, discovery and winning business.

There’ll be a practical stage - not to catch you out, but to understand how you approach real situations. And a final conversation to make sure expectations are aligned on both sides.

No unnecessary hoops. Just enough to understand how you operate. And for you to understand how we operate. Win-Win.

title: Senior Growth Marketing Manager, Upper Funnel
description:
Who We Are

Verkada is transforming how organizations protect their people and places with an integrated, privacy-sensitive AI-powered platform that includes solutions for video security, access control, air quality sensors, alarms, intercoms, and visitor management. 

We’ve got serious momentum in the market: more than 30,000 customers (including 100+ of the Fortune 500), a $5.8B valuation , more than $1 billion in annualized bookings, and backing from CapitalG, Sequoia Capital, General Catalyst, Felicis Ventures, Next47 and more. Physical AI is one of the most consequential technology shifts of our time, and Verkada is at the center of it.

You can look at all kinds of communities to see our platform’s impact in the world. It's the retailer that uses our agentic AI to deter theft before it happens. The warehouse that uses AI-powered alerts to make sure its team is protected on the floor with proper PPE. The school that’s alerted to a threat in real-time and triggers a lockdown in seconds, not minutes. We’re rapidly scaling this impact: today, more than 2 million Verkada devices are deployed across 170+ countries. 

About the Role

At Verkada, we're known to push traditional boundaries, and our B2B growth efforts are no exception. We’re reinventing Growth here. As a Senior Growth Marketing Manager: Upper Funnel , you’ll be part of a high-performing team with backgrounds spanning investment banking, consulting, marketing, and high-growth startups. 

In this role, you’ll own Verkada’s top-of-funnel campaigns and how we measure them. You’ll answer three questions again and again: What should we run? Who should we run it to? And what did we learn, so we can do it again? You’ll test channels most B2B companies never try, from CTV to audio to billboards, and build the measurement to prove what works. This is a highly visible, high-autonomy role that offers the opportunity to directly shape how the market sees Verkada.

We are committed to a thriving in-office culture. This role requires that you be on-site at our HQ in San Mateo, CA 5 days a week (with flexible hours).

What You’ll Do

• Creative & Story: Decide what we run. Think critically about ads, messages, and formats, and what works best on each platform. Partner with our creative team to turn Verkada’s story into campaigns that people remember.

• Audience Strategy: Decide who is worth spending money on. Build ICP and account-list targeting, and choose the right channel mix to reach them.

• Channel & Vendor Testing: Continuously test new channels, inventory, and vendors across CTV, YouTube, LinkedIn, audio, and out-of-home to find the best targeting at the best cost.

• Measurement & Incrementality: Design and read geo-lift tests, holdouts, and conversion lift studies. Devise ways to measure impact from channels that are hard to attribute, like billboards and audio. Own key metrics like website visitors.

• Budget Ownership: Make real spend decisions and move budget toward what works, based on evidence.

• Learning Loop & Insights: Keep a clear record of what we tested and what we learned. Turn results into the next plan and share insights with leadership and across teams.

What You Bring

• 7+ years of experience in growth marketing, performance marketing, paid media, marketing science, a startup or equivalent.

• Hands-on experience buying media, and the confidence to make decisions about spending real money.

• A clear answer to the question, “How did you know it worked?” You have designed and read at least one incrementality test yourself, such as a geo-lift, matched-market, or holdout test.

• A strong point of view on creative and story: you can explain why a campaign was good, what helped it, and what hurt it.

• Proficiency in data analysis. Knowledge of SQL and Excel preferred.

• Experience with CTV, out-of-home, audio, or account-based marketing (ABM) campaigns is a plus.

title: Clinical Risk Management Lead
description:
Become a part of our caring community

The Clinical Risk Management Lead supports clinical risk management activities across the Primary Care Organization (PCO) by identifying, assessing, monitoring, and mitigating risks related to clinical practice, patient care, regulatory compliance, and operational processes. This role partners with clinical and business leaders to evaluate risk exposure, assess existing controls, recommend improvements, and support the implementation of risk management strategies that align with organizational objectives. You will report to the Associate VP, Risk Management. The position works closely with leaders across CenterWell Senior Primary Care , Conviva, and MaxHealth, as well as cross-functional partners in Compliance, Legal, Privacy, Human Resources, and Enterprise Health & Safety. The Clinical Risk Management Lead also serves as a clinical subject matter resource, providing guidance on clinical risk management, control design, issue mitigation, and regulatory considerations.

Key Responsibilities

• Conduct clinical risk assessments to identify, evaluate, and prioritize risks related to clinical operations, patient care, and healthcare delivery.

• Develop and execute clinical risk management plans, including assessment of existing controls and recommendations for risk mitigation strategies.

• Partner with clinical leadership to evaluate risks and support the implementation of effective controls and corrective actions.

• Present findings, recommendations, and risk mitigation strategies to leadership and key stakeholders.

• Collaborate with Compliance, Legal, Privacy, Human Resources, Enterprise Health & Safety, and other internal teams on risk-related initiatives.

• Identify, document, and support resolution of business issues related to clinical practice and operational processes.

• Guide business and clinical partners through risk mitigation and corrective action planning.

• Conduct research, gather information, interview stakeholders, and evaluate clinical risk scenarios to support objective risk assessments.

• Monitor emerging risks, trends, and regulatory requirements affecting primary care and value-based care operations.

• Support continuous improvement efforts related to risk management frameworks, controls, and clinical governance processes.

Use your skills to make an impact

Required Qualifications

• Bachelor's degree or higher in Nursing, Physician Assistant Studies, or a related clinical discipline.

• Active and unrestricted clinical license.

• 5+ years of clinical healthcare experience.

• Experience collaborating with clinical leadership and interdisciplinary stakeholders.

• Strong analytical, communication, problem-solving, and risk assessment skills.

• Ability to evaluate clinical processes, identify risks, and recommend practical solutions.

• Experience presenting recommendations and findings to leadership audiences.

Preferred Qualifications

• Advanced Practice Registered Nurse (APRN) or Physician Assistant (PA) designation.

• 3+ years of experience in risk management, compliance, audit, healthcare quality, patient safety, clinical operations, or related fields.

• Experience within value-based care, population health, primary care, Medicare Advantage, or managed care environments.

• Knowledge of healthcare regulations, internal controls, clinical governance, and risk management frameworks.

• Familiarity with healthcare operational processes, quality improvement initiatives, and regulatory compliance programs.

description:

At OKX, we believe that the future will be reshaped by crypto, and ultimately contribute to every individual's freedom.

OKX is a leading crypto exchange, and the developer of OKX Wallet, giving millions access to crypto trading and decentralized crypto applications (dApps). OKX is also a trusted brand by hundreds of large institutions seeking access to crypto markets. We are safe and reliable, backed by our Proof of Reserves.

Across our multiple offices globally, we are united by our core principles:  We Before Me , Do the Right Thing , and Get Things Done . These shared values drive our culture, shape our processes, and foster a friendly, rewarding, and diverse environment for every OK-er. OKX is part of OKG, a group that brings the value of Blockchain to users around the world, through our leading products OKX, OKX Wallet, OKLink and more.

About the Team

The Global Physical Security Team (PST) helps protect OKX personnel, executives, facilities, events, and business operations from physical and security-related threats worldwide.

PST takes an intelligence-led, risk-based approach encompassing executive protection, travel security, workplace and event security, protective intelligence, incident response, security technology, and third-party security services.

The team works closely with internal stakeholders, external security providers, emergency services, and law enforcement, as appropriate.

This position requires sound judgment, operational leadership, adaptability, and the ability to make proportionate, risk-based decisions in complex and rapidly evolving environments.
